method.warmup: First 2000 rows of the same fixture, two REML iterations, fresh model.
method.timed_region: Model construction and complete public fit_reml call, max_reml_iter=30.
method.outputs: Predictions and coefficients saved after the timed region.
method.memory: Fresh-process ru_maxrss immediately after fit, includes imports and warmup, excludes prediction.
method.ordering: Serial interleaved sources/thread counts with rotated order between repeats.
method.comparison_outputs: First matching candidate and baseline receipt; fixture hashes checked.
method.profiles: Separate instrumented runs, excluded from unprofiled timing ratios; selected kernel counters retained.
limitations: Warmed sample on one virtual machine; not a cold-start or broad family/dataset survey.
One master reference per thread setting; three candidate and pre-Gram repetitions on 100k cases.
The 300k and Gamma comparisons each have one run per completed source.
Runtime fit arithmetic stayed unchanged after this campaign; subsequent source changes add public-warmup compilation calls only.
